title: Dual Exam: Controlled Evaluation of Multimodal Agents and World Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.31066v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: World Models (WMs) can support Multimodal Agents (MAs) through simulated experience, while Agent trajectories can inform World Model refinement. Evaluating this interaction requires separate evidence about action selection and state evolution. We introduce Dual Exam, which tests Agents under fixed environment response mechanisms and World Models under fixed action interventions across physical, digital, social, and scientific domains. The Agent track compares 10 configurations on 1,088 items in 15 reporting categories. The World Model track contains 400 cases across eight scenarios; 15 configurations have full coverage and one covers six scenarios. GPT 6 Astra leads the case-weighted Agent Index at 31.3, and GPT-Image-2 leads the full-coverage WM Overall at 21.7. These scores use different tasks and metrics and are not directly comparable. A 150-case pilot of one coupled pairing records zero task successes and motivates component-lev

translated_title: 双重考试：多模态智能体与世界模型的可控评估
translated_abstract: 世界模型（WM）可以通过模拟经验来支持多模态智能体（MA），而智能体的轨迹信息也可以用于世界模型的改进。评估这种交互作用需要分别获取关于动作选择和状态演化的独立证据。我们提出了Dual Exam（双重考试），它在固定的环境响应机制下测试智能体，并在固定的动作干预下测试世界模型，涵盖物理、数字、社会和科学领域。智能体赛道在15个报告类别中对1,088个项目上的10种配置进行了比较。世界模型赛道包含8个场景中的400个案例；其中15种配置实现了全覆盖，另一种配置覆盖了六个场景。GPT 6 Astra以31.3分在案例加权的智能体指数中领先，GPT-Image-2以21.7分在全覆盖的世界模型总分中领先。这些分数使用不同的任务和指标，因此不能直接比较。一项针对单一耦合配对的150案例试点实验记录到零任务成功，这促使了对组件级别的进一步分析。
tldr: 本文提出Dual Exam评估框架，通过在固定环境响应机制下测试多模态智能体、在固定动作干预下测试世界模型，实现了对两者交互能力的可控分离评估。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Dual Exam, a controlled evaluation framework that separately assesses multimodal agents under fixed environment responses and world models under fixed action interventions across physical, digital, social, and scientific domains.
